audit.whatIsWrong: Every level-chart row disagreed with its own why text: rows read Skill/Kennen/Kennen/Skill/Skill/Kennen/Kennen while the whys say Karma out-ranges him at 1, out-paces his energy at 2, chunks him pre-6, peaks at 4-5, loses the level-6 window, and re-takes the lane on first item.
audit.why: Kennen has no gap-closer until Lightning Rush and his energy bar cannot sustain a poke war against Karma's 950-range Q with Gathering Fire refunds. His one clear window is 6. Win rate is 64.29%.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Karma, Karma, Karma, Karma, Kennen, Karma, Skill in both layers — the level-6 row is his, the 2+ item row splits because his Maelstrom scales in fights while Karma out-items the lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 why was generic boilerplate that never named Slicing Maelstrom or its cost.
audit.why: Slicing Maelstrom is 120s flat, 550 range, and only lands its full stun through Mark of the Storm stacks.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with the 120s cooldown, the 550 range and the three-stack stun condition.

audit.whatIsWrong: Electrical Surge (W) applying on-hit magic damage is never mentioned, and the Mark of the Storm stun-count rule is only implied.
audit.why: W is onHit-flagged, 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6s, and stacks a Mark; the passive stuns on the third mark. Lightning Rush is 170 range on 10/9/8/7/6s and applies one mark on pass-through — so a single Rush is not a stun by itself.
audit.corrected: On-hit / MR-not-armour line added to the Do's, the two-marks warning to the Don'ts, and the Rush mark-count into the interactions row.

audit.why: All three packet suspectNames ('Slicing Maelstrom', 'Lightning Rush', 'Inner Flame') match the kit files exactly — false positives, no change made.

edits.before: No new ultimate at 6 — your Mantra has been online since level 1. His spike is the danger window: respect it.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom is a 120s, 550-range AoE stun off three Mark of the Storm stacks — never be grouped when he flanks.

edits.before: Kennen spends Lightning Rush early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Electrical Surge is on-hit magic damage on 13s at rank 1 — MR, not armour, cuts his chip.

edits.before: That is Kennen’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Two Marks on you means the third stuns — reset before it lands.

edits.before: Track Kennen’s Lightning Rush: His engage and escape — the stun chain starts here. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Lightning Rush is 10s at rank 1 and only 170 range — it applies one Mark on pass-through, so his stun still needs two more.
